description: Hand-set win-model weights (B's judgement, plan §3). p_win = logistic(logit(baseRate[reason]) + stage[stage] + Σ features[f] · x_f). Tune with pnpm eval:calibrate, which writes weights.v1.json.

notes.baseRates: Win rate with no evidence at all. Not-as-described is hardest to win (it's the buyer's word about the item); not-received easiest (tracking is objective).
notes.stage: Logit shift by lifecycle stage: each escalation means PayPal or the card network has already seen the buyer's side and found it plausible.
notes.completeness: Matrix completeness score minus 0.5. Broad 'how much of the evidence PayPal asks for do we have'.
notes.required_met: 1 when every required item for the reason is present. Missing required evidence loses most disputes.
notes.delivery_proof: Not-received/unauthorised, physical: 1 for delivery to the address on file, 0.4 for delivery elsewhere (not-received only). The single strongest not-received signal.
notes.signature: Not-received, physical: signature confirmation on the delivery scan.
notes.shipment_problem: Not-received, physical: 1 if returned/failed, 0.5 if still in transit. Strong evidence for the buyer.
notes.no_tracking: Not-received, physical: no carrier tracking at all.
notes.digital_access: Digital goods: the buyer downloaded or accessed the item after purchase.
notes.listing_snapshot: Not-as-described: a listing snapshot from before the order exists.
notes.item_photos: Not-as-described: packing photos of the item as shipped.
notes.seller_responsive: The seller replied to the buyer. Small: reviewers notice good-faith communication.
notes.checkout_verified: Unauthorised: AVS or CVV matched at checkout.
notes.device_ip_match: Unauthorised: checkout device or IP seen on the buyer's earlier orders.
notes.repeat_customer: Unauthorised: log2(1 + earlier undisputed orders) / 2, capped at 1.
notes.fraud_signals: Unauthorised: share of {AVS mismatch, unknown IP and device, delivered to another postal code}. Added after the eval showed explicit fraud signs were ignored (case H14).
notes.buyer_dispute_history: min(earlier disputes, 3) / 3. Serial disputers are less credible but PayPal still weighs each case on its own.
notes.refund_proof: Credit-not-processed, duplicate, paid-by-other-means: a refund record exists.
notes.late_dispute: Days from payment to dispute / 180, capped at 1. Late claims are slightly weaker.
notes.amount_log: log10(amount / $50). Larger disputes get closer scrutiny.
